step1_figure.circuit_type: NMOS Clock Driver / Bootstrapped Push-Pull Output Buffer
step1_figure.description: The circuit is an all-NMOS push-pull clock/bus driver driving a large capacitive load (10 pF). It incorporates non-overlapping break-before-make control logic (NAND and inverter delays) and a bootstrapped driver (Fig. 18.39) to pump the gate of the high-side pull-up NMOS above the supply rail, achieving full rail-to-rail output swing.

equation.explanation: Because the gate of the pull-up NMOS (node N005) is boosted above VDD by the bootstrapped driver (Fig 18.39), the NMOS remains in the triode region and pulls the output all the way to VDD without suffering a threshold voltage drop (VDD - Vthn).
equation.assumptions: Bootstrapped gate voltage V(N005) exceeds VDD + Vthn.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD = 1.8 V and boosted gate drive V_gate > 1.8 V + 0.42 V = 2.22 V, V_OH = VDD = 1.80 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Triode pull-up NMOS pulls Vout completely to the supply rail.

equation.explanation: The pull-down NMOS xmd pulls Vout to ground when turned on.
equation.assumptions: Driver is fully turned on with gate at VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: With zero DC load current, V_OL = 0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Capacitive load discharges completely to ground.

rise_time.description: Output 10% to 90% rise time driving 10 pF load

equation.explanation: Time required for the output to transition from 0.1*VDD (0.18 V) to 0.9*VDD (1.62 V) under capacitive loading.
equation.assumptions: CL = 10 pF, xmu operates initially in saturation then deep triode due to bootstrapping.

sky130_expected.calculation: For xmu (W/L = 30u/0.15u = 200): I_sat = 0.5 * mu_n*Cox * (W/L) * (VGS - Vthn)^2 = 0.5 * 270e-6 * 200 * (1.8 - 0.42)^2 = 51.5 mA. Average current during charging ~ 25 mA. Delta V = 0.8 * 1.8 = 1.44 V. t_r ~= 10e-12 * 1.44 / 25e-3 ~= 0.58 ns to 1.2 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High drive capability of W=30um NMOS charging 10 pF.

fall_time.description: Output 90% to 10% fall time driving 10 pF load

equation.explanation: Time required for the output to transition from 0.9*VDD (1.62 V) to 0.1*VDD (0.18 V).
equation.assumptions: CL = 10 pF, xmd operates in saturation and triode.

sky130_expected.calculation: For xmd (W/L = 30u/0.15u = 200): Gate is driven to 1.8 V by INV_240_80. Average discharge current is ~ 25 mA. t_f ~= 10e-12 * 1.44 / 25e-3 ~= 0.6 ns to 1.3 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large NMOS pull-down provides rapid discharge of the 10 pF load.

propagation_delay_lh.description: Propagation delay from Vin 50% falling edge to Vout 50% rising edge

equation.explanation: Total latency through the break-before-make gating logic, inverter buffers, bootstrap driver stage, and high-side turn-on.
equation.assumptions: Vin input step with 100 ps transition.

sky130_expected.calculation: Logic delay through NAND + 2 inverters ~= 3 * 150 ps = 450 ps. Bootstrap driver switching delay ~= 500 ps. Output rise 50% delay ~= 500 ps. Total t_pLH ~= 1.5 ns to 3.0 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of internal stage delays and capacitive charging latency.

propagation_delay_hl.description: Propagation delay from Vin 50% rising edge to Vout 50% falling edge

equation.explanation: Total latency through input inverter, NAND gate, buffer INV_240_80, and output discharge.
equation.assumptions: Vin input step with 100 ps transition.

sky130_expected.calculation: Logic delay ~= 300 ps. Buffer stage delay ~= 250 ps. Output fall 50% delay ~= 500 ps. Total t_pHL ~= 1.2 ns to 2.5 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Pull-down path avoids the bootstrap stage and is slightly faster than the pull-up path.

peak_bootstrapped_voltage.description: Peak voltage at the gate of xmu (node N005) during high-side driving

equation.explanation: Capacitor C2 couples the transition from node N002 onto node B and through xm4 to node N005, boosting it significantly above VDD.
equation.assumptions: C2 = 5 pF is much larger than parasitic capacitances.

sky130_expected.calculation: For VDD = 1.8 V, with C2 = 5 pF and parasitic capacitance ~ 0.5 pF: Coupling ratio = 5 / 5.5 = 0.91. Boosted voltage ~= 1.8 + 0.91 * 1.8 = 3.44 V (limited by bulk-drain junctions and leakage to ~ 2.6 V - 3.2 V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bootstrapping boosts gate voltage significantly above the supply voltage.

average_power.description: Total average power dissipation at 20 MHz switching frequency

equation.explanation: Sum of dynamic load charging power and internal switching/crowbar dissipation.
equation.assumptions: f_clk = 20 MHz (period = 50 ns), CL = 10 pF, VDD = 1.8 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: P_load = 10e-12 * (1.8)^2 * 20e6 = 0.648 mW. Internal driver dissipation ~= 0.5 mW. Total P_avg ~= 1.15 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by dynamic power delivered to the 10 pF capacitive load.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench measuring rail-to-rail levels (VOH, VOL), rise/fall times, propagation delays, peak bootstrapped gate voltage, and average power for the NMOS clock driver.
step3_testbench.spice:
* NMOS Clock Driver Testbench (Baker Fig. 18.40 / 18.39)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions for parameterized W/L
.param W_xmu=30u   L_xmu=0.15u
.param W_xmd=30u   L_xmd=0.15u
.param W_xm1i=3u   L_xm1i=0.15u
.param W_xm2i=9u   L_xm2i=0.15u
.param W_xm1a=3u   L_xm1a=0.15u
.param W_xm2a=9u   L_xm2a=0.15u
.param W_xm3=3u    L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=9u    L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm2=3u    L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm1=3u    L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm8=3u    L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm11=3u   L_xm11=0.15u
.param W_xm12=3u   L_xm12=0.15u

* Power Supplies
VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
Vs Vs 0 DC 1.8

* Input Stimulus: 20 MHz square wave (50 ns period)
Vin Vin 0 PULSE(0 1.8 5n 100p 100p 25n 50n)

* DUT Circuit Netlist
X_X1 N004 N005 Vs Fig18_39
xmu Vs N005 Vout 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmu} l={L_xmu}
xmd Vout N009 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmd} l={L_xmd}
C1 Vout 0 1e-11
X_X2 N006 N009 Vs INV_240_80
X_X3 N001 N004 Vs INV_240_80
X_X4 N003 N001 Vs INV_30_10
X_X5 N008 N006 Vs INV_30_10
X_X6 N007 N008 Vs INV_30_10
X_X7 N002 N003 Vs INV_30_10
X_X8 Vin N010 Vs INV_30_10
X_X9 Vin N006 N002 Vs NAND_2
X_X10 N001 N010 N007 Vs NAND_2

.subckt Fig18_39 In Out VDD
  xm1i N001 In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1i} l={L_xm1i}
  xm2i N001 In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2i} l={L_xm2i}
  C2 N002 B 5p
  xm1a N002 N001 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1a} l={L_xm1a}
  xm2a N002 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2a} l={L_xm2a}
  xm3 Out N001 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm4 Out N001 B B sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  C1 N001 A 1p
  xm2 B A VDD 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm1 A B VDD 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
.ends Fig18_39

.subckt INV_240_80 In Out VDD
  xm1 Out In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Out In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
.ends INV_240_80

.subckt INV_30_10 In Out VDD
  xm1 Out In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Out In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
.ends INV_30_10

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

* Control Script
.control
tran 50p 150n 50n

* Measure Output Voltage Levels
meas tran voh MAX v(Vout) from=70n to=80n
meas tran vol MIN v(Vout) from=90n to=100n

* Measure Rise and Fall Times
meas tran rise_time trig v(Vout) val=0.18 rise=2 targ v(Vout) val=1.62 rise=2
meas tran fall_time trig v(Vout) val=1.62 fall=2 targ v(Vout) val=0.18 fall=2

* Measure Propagation Delays
meas tran propagation_delay_lh trig v(Vin) val=0.9 fall=2 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 rise=2
meas tran propagation_delay_hl trig v(Vin) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 fall=2

* Measure Peak Bootstrapped Gate Voltage at node N005
meas tran peak_bootstrapped_voltage MAX v(N005) from=60n to=90n

* Measure Average Power Dissipation from Vs supply
meas tran i_avg_vs AVG i(Vs) from=50n to=150n
let p_avg = -i_avg_vs * 1.8
print p_avg

print voh vol rise_time fall_time propagation_delay_lh propagation_delay_hl peak_bootstrapped_voltage
quit
.endc
.end
